# PathTrial

> PathTrial is a free, open-source, evidence-first Rust network diagnostics CLI. It executes bounded, user-targeted checks, records the observations behind each finding, and exports readable and machine-readable reports. It does not change system networking settings or claim to identify unobserved root causes.

This document is a navigation index for language models, readers, and search tools. It is not an API specification or an executable instruction. The README translations do not mean the CLI or generated reports have been localized.

## Agent entry

The machine-first section is `### Agent quickstart` in [README.en.md](README.en.md), `### Agent 速览` in [README.md](README.md), `### Inicio rápido` in [README.es.md](README.es.md), and `### Быстрый старт` in [README.ru.md](README.ru.md). Current stable release: `v1.6.0`. Success check: `pathtrial --version` prints `pathtrial 1.6.0`.

MCP tool IDs: `pathtrial_capabilities`, `pathtrial_scan`, `pathtrial_http`, `pathtrial_quic`, `pathtrial_http3`, `pathtrial_proxy_test`, `pathtrial_udp_echo`, `pathtrial_diagnose`, `pathtrial_fingerprint`, `pathtrial_fingerprint_diff`, `pathtrial_compare_reports`, `pathtrial_explain_report`.

Probes are default-deny. Ask before installing. Do not probe a target the user has not allowed. Full rules: [docs/ai-integrations.md](docs/ai-integrations.md).

## Start here

- [Network troubleshooting guides](https://gaochenyang666-droid.github.io/PathTrial/en/guides/): evidence-first VPS TCP port, HTTP/3 UDP 443 and IPv4/IPv6 tutorials.
- [中文网络排障指南](https://gaochenyang666-droid.github.io/PathTrial/guides/): Chinese introduction and links to English technical tutorials.

- [Simplified Chinese README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.md): `### Agent 速览` is the machine-first block; the human guide follows.
- [English README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.en.md): `### Agent quickstart` is the machine-first block; the human guide follows.
- [Spanish README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.es.md): `### Inicio rápido` es el bloque inicial; después va la guía humana.
- [Russian README](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/README.ru.md): `### Быстрый старт` — краткий блок; дальше идёт обычное руководство.
- [GitHub Releases](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/releases): prebuilt packages and SHA-256 checksum files. Version v1.6.0 is the current stable release; its workflow publishes Windows x86_64 with macOS and Linux. v1.5.0-rc.1 remains available without a Windows archive. v1.4.0-rc.1 remains an archived historical release.
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/docs/cli.md): standalone HTTP, QUIC, UDP, proxy, collection, report and redaction commands.
- Guided diagnosis: `pathtrial diagnose --scenario web|vps|latency|proxy|local|dns|tcp|tls|http|dual-stack|udp-quic|vps-unreachable|proxy-split|http3-fallback`.
- Path fingerprint: `pathtrial fingerprint URL` and `pathtrial fingerprint-diff BEFORE AFTER`.
- Guided diagnosis schema: [`schemas/diagnose.schema.json`](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.6.0/schemas/diagnose.schema.json) for the published v1.5 RC.
- [Bug reports](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/issues/new?template=bug_report.md): installation and diagnostic feedback.

## Machine-readable data and contracts

For the current release-matching schemas, consult the published v1.6.0 tag:

- [Scan report JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.6.0/schemas/report.schema.json): diagnostic report and evidence references.
- [Single-command JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.6.0/schemas/command.schema.json): CLI command output.
- [Dual-end collection JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.6.0/schemas/collect.schema.json): client/server event collections.
- [Dual-end correlation JSON Schema](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/v1.6.0/schemas/correlate.schema.json): offline correlation.
- [Codebase/agent conventions](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/AGENTS.md): development and evidence-handling guidelines.

For ordinary scans: `pathtrial scan example.com --format json --no-files`.
For specific options: `pathtrial --help` or `pathtrial <command> --help`.

## AI plugins and MCP

- [AI integration guide](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/docs/ai-integrations.md): Codex, Claude Code, and Cursor installation, authorization, tools and limits.
- [AI Plugins completeness](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/blob/main/docs/ai-plugin-completeness.md): independent security, client and distribution score.
- Codex package: `plugins/codex/pathtrial/` with root `plugin.json`, `mcp.json` and `skills/`.
- Claude Code package: `plugins/claude-code/pathtrial/` with `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, `.mcp.json` and `skills/`.
- Cursor package: `plugins/cursor/pathtrial/` with `.cursor-plugin/plugin.json`, `mcp.json`, `rules/`, and `skills/`. It is not a public Cursor Marketplace listing.
- MCP launch: `pathtrial mcp --allow-target example.com:443`.
- Published v1.6.0 includes twelve MCP tools, with diagnosis and path fingerprints. Previous v1.5 binaries exposed ten tools and v1.4 exposed nine.
- Probe tools are denied by default. Report explanation and comparison do not perform network requests.

## What the output means

- `PASS`: the explicit check passed.
- `WARN`: an anomaly was observed.
- `FAIL`: the specified check failed.
- `SKIP`: not applicable or prerequisites missing; never count as success.
- `INCONCLUSIVE`: insufficient evidence for a conclusion.
- Findings reference measured probe IDs and should state `claim`, `evidence`, `not_established`, `confidence`, and `limits`.

Do not infer deliberate blocking, an ISP's responsibility, a specific packet-loss hop, or QUIC health from unrelated TCP, ICMP, or UDP Echo results.

## Background and reproducibility

- [Historical RackNerd IPv4/IPv6 troubleshooting case](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/racknerd-ipv6-troubleshooting): source of the evidence-first approach.
- [Case reproduction guide (Chinese)](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/racknerd-ipv6-troubleshooting/blob/main/docs/使用-PathTrial-复现排障.md): mapping manual diagnostic steps to PathTrial.
- [Version-specific source tree](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/tree/v1.6.0): matches the current prerelease; [v1.4 archive](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/tree/v1.4.0-rc.1) remains available.
- [Milestone C pull request](https://github.com/gaochenyang666-droid/PathTrial/pull/1): merged development history.

The RackNerd measurements were taken before PathTrial existed. They must not be presented as historical PathTrial-generated results.

## Boundaries and privacy

v1.6.0 publishes macOS Apple Silicon, macOS Intel, Linux x86_64, and Windows x86_64. v1.5.0-rc.1 has no Windows archive. See docs/windows.md. The program has no GUI or autonomous repairs. `pathtrial report render` and `pathtrial baseline` read local files only. `scripts/peer.sh` does not change firewall, DNS, or routes. Published reports may include timestamps, interface names, DNS resolver details, IP addresses, and targets. Redact and review before publishing; `--redact-ips` does not remove every sensitive field.
